title: Rust: GET /config client
description: Acceptance: Rust client can fetch config
close_reason: Implemented Rust GET /config client and public NodeConfig model. Sends byte-exact GET to /config, rejects non-success CoAP codes, decodes one complete string-keyed CBOR map, exposes spec fields (name/role/radio/identity), preserves extension values, and rejects malformed/non-map/non-text-key/truncated/trailing payloads. Added focused UDP wire and decoding tests. Green: cargo test -p lichen-client --features tokio --locked (85 unit + 16 integration); focused config tests 6/6; cargo clippy -p lichen-client --lib --features tokio --locked -- -D warnings; cargo check --no-default-features --lib; cargo fmt --check.
